# Quotation response -- SOLMU-RFQ-2026-14

## Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is a technical property maintenance contractor based in Jyvaskyla, covering LVI, electrical, building automation and property upkeep for around 180 staff serving clients across Central Finland, including shopping centre and retail properties.

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy meets all four eligibility requirements: our liability insurance, electrical contracting rights, qualifying reference projects and annual revenue all satisfy the thresholds set out in Section 3.

### Technical response

**Condition monitoring.** Data is collected during scheduled visits and logged for trend review.

**Continuity.** Assignments are staffed by a team, with 26 administrative staff supporting contract management as backup capacity should personnel change.

**Waste handling.** Waste is sorted on site per the applicable plan.

**Documentation handover.** The property register and associated documentation are maintained and handed over as required.

**Periodic electrical inspections.** Carried out per the statutory schedule.

**Worker qualifications.** Field staff hold the qualifications required for site work.

**Spare parts.** Availability and lead times are stated by part class.

**Service visits.** Content and scheduling of visits are agreed with centre management.

**Emergency response.** Section 4.10 of this request states a response time of 4 hours from notification. Annex B's cross-reference to the technical specification states 2 hours for the same requirement. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy and requests clarification on which figure governs; our proposal is costed to meet the 2-hour figure as the more demanding of the two.

### Commercial terms

Contract period is 3 years, with the option described in Section 5. Billing frequency and cost breakdown are provided as required.

### Forms

Trade register extract and tax payment certificate are enclosed.

### Quotation format

Submitted as a single PDF, price stated as EUR/m2/year, within the page limit.

### Annex A -- additional technical requirements

Building envelope condition is assessed periodically and reported to centre management. A safety plan is in place for all work.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

See the flagged response-time discrepancy above. A volume discount structure applies under the framework. Insurance certificate and key personnel CVs are enclosed.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to submit this quotation.
